caption: The drawing depicts a small figurine of a deer or stag, positioned seated on an oval base. The body of the deer is primarily brown with darker stripes and shading to suggest texture and form, while the underbelly and some parts of the legs are lighter. The antlers are painted a muted brown, distinct from the rest of the body. The ears and tip of the nose are highlighted in reddish-pink hues, and the eyes are small, dark, and round. The base on which the deer rests is oval-shaped, featuring a ribbed texture and colored in a yellowish brown with a green outer rim. The background is plain and uncolored, with no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Deer
